WHAT YOUR PORTFOLIO SHOULD SHOW

BRAND STYLE FOR REFERENCE

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Clipper — Viral Reels & TikToks (High Volume, Ongoing)
description:
READ THIS FIRST — to filter yourself in or out:



The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is __________.



Answer that in 2-3 sentences from your OWN editing experience (NOT ChatGPT, NOT a template). If you can't, this role isn't for you — I'll skip applications that don't lead with that answer.



If your application starts with "I am a passionate and dedicated video editor with excellent skills" — I will skip it. I want one specific kind of editor, not a stock cover letter.



---



We're a New Zealand AI-powered marketing agency. We grow businesses and creators on short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), and we're producing a HIGH volume of content — aiming for ~10 finished videos per day across a small team of editors.



We're hiring SEVERAL short-form editors / clippers at once. We send you raw footage + a clear brief, you cut it into dynamic, retention-led short-form videos in the style of the best creators online. Fast turnaround, ongoing work, room to take on more videos (and more pay) as you prove out.



THE STYLE WE WANT — study these before applying:

- WATCH OUR FIRST EDITED VIDEO — this is the exact standard + style you'll be matching: 

- Devin Jatho 
 is our north star for editing style. Watch a few of his videos before you apply.

- Fast, dynamic cuts. Punchy 1-second hooks. Clean animated captions. Zooms, pattern interrupts, B-roll, sound design that lands on the beat.

- Modern, high-retention, "scroll-stopping" — NOT slow corporate edits, NOT cheesy sound-effect spam.

- We'll send the raw footage + a per-project brief so you know exactly what to cut.



WHAT THESE VIDEOS ARE FOR:

The content promotes our Social Growth Plan — 
 — a done-for-you content-strategy product for creators and founders. You'll be editing videos built to grow our audience and drive viewers to that page, so every edit needs to hold attention to the very end and land the call-to-action cleanly.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Receive raw clips + a written brief (hook, beats, on-screen text, pacing notes, reference)

- Cut 9:16 vertical short-form videos to a viral standard

- Animated captions, on-screen text, trending-audio sync, tight pacing, clean exports

- Turn videos around fast — this is a volume role; ideally you can do 2+ per day

- Keep a consistent style across videos while adapting per brief



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT:

- Short-form editing in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / After Effects (DaVinci fine)

- Hook-first retention editing — you understand WHY a video holds attention, not just making it pretty

- Clean animated captions + on-screen text (accurate, well-timed, on-brand)

- Working fast to a brief without quality dropping

- Clear English communication and reliable turnaround



NICE TO HAVE:

- Reusable caption / motion-graphics templates

- A feel for what's trending on Reels / TikTok right now

- Experience editing founder-led / talking-head + B-roll content



THE SETUP:

- Per-video pay (you quote your rate). Ongoing volume — the better and faster you are, the more videos we send you.

- Paid test edit: we send one set of raw clips + a brief, you return one finished short. We pay $5 USD for the test regardless of outcome.

- This is a real, ongoing role with room to grow into more videos/day and a higher per-video rate as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY — send these THREE things, in this order:



1. Your 2-3 sentence answer to: "The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is ___" (your own experience, not ChatGPT)



2. 2-3 short-form videos YOU personally edited — DIRECT video links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or specific Drive/Dropbox FILE links — NOT folders, NOT showreels).



3. Your per-video rate (USD) + how many videos per day you can realistically deliver.



I reply within 48 hours and pay $5 USD for a short test edit if your samples fit.



WHAT I WILL NOT REPLY TO:

- Agency
s ("we are a team of 50 editors")

title: Executive and Operations VA
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a personal VA role supporting an individual entrepreneur across multiple ventures: watch trading, furniture reselling, monstera/plant sales, and a patches & pins e-commerce brand. The person you're supporting moves fast, has high standards, and is deeply invested in each business — this is not a corporate inbox management job.

The right person is detail-obsessed, self-directed, and comfortable working across platforms and marketplaces. You'll be trusted with real inventory, real listings, and real customer interactions from day one. The goal is to remove the principal from the repetitive parts of the workflow so they can focus on sourcing, strategy, and growth.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Watches — Core Workflow

• Add newly purchased watches to the CRM and iCloud inventory folder with complete, accurate details

• Prepare watch descriptions using provided templates and research (history, specifications, model context)

• Upload listings to Chrono24, Grailzee Pro, eBay, and the Shopify website — images, descriptions, pricing

• Monitor and reply to buyer inquiries using approved message templates; escalate non-standard situations

• Perform weekly price checks: review recent sold comps, update CRM with current market notes

• Flag watches needing service or authentication and move them to the correct stage in the CRM workflow

• Keep folder structure and CRM diligently updated — every piece accounted for, every status current

Furniture & Plants

• List and relist furniture on Craigslist,
 Marketplace, and OfferUp — write descriptions, set pricing, upload photos

• Manage buyer messages, schedule pickups, and follow the reply templates provided

• Apply the same rhythm and discipline to succulents/plants and Squarespace site updates as needed

Patches & Pins — National Park Distribution Push

• Research management companies that operate gift shops inside national park visitor centers (Grand Canyon, Yosemite, Rocky Mountains, etc.)

• Build a contact database: company names, buyer contacts, distribution center info

• Draft and send outreach using approved templates; track responses and follow-up cadence

• Help prepare a pitch package covering product quality, scalability, and initial order structure

Social Media & Content

• Post to Instagram,
, and TikTok from a provided image/video library — watches and furniture

• Draft captions and post copy using ChatGPT/Claude based on brand voice guidelines

• Research watch brand and model histories for blog-style write-ups and social content

• Source relevant YouTube videos; compile notes or draft scripts for potential faceless YouTube content (future phase)

• Prepare short-form video concepts or clip selections for TikTok — no on-camera presence required

Photography Support (As Needed)

• Follow the established photo editing workflow: watermarking, square-format cropping, light adjustments

• Coordinate with local photography services — brief them, receive files, prep for listing

Research & Scheduling — Ad Hoc Projects

• Conduct structured research projects (example: LA nursery lots via LAWP parcel database — build a custom map with parcel IDs, current tenants, lease status)

• Send outreach
s from templates, schedule meetings in designated time blocks, and follow up reliably

• Support recurring research tasks related to irrigation, plant sourcing, or other property/garden projects

 About Us



We are a growing Amazon FBA business looking for a dedicated long-term tea
mber to help source profitable products for resale on Amazon.



This is not a simple data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands Online Arbitrage sourcing, product analysis, Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, supplier lead times, gift card opportunities, coupon stacking, cash-back programs, and overall Amazon seller profitability.



We prefer someone who is committed to working exclusively with our company and is not sourcing for multiple Amazon sellers at the same time.



 Compensation



* Long-term opportunity with room for growth

* Starting Pay: $2.50 - $5.00 USD per hour with room for growth

* Performance bonuses available

 Were flexible on hours as long as work out put is consistent and quality remains high

* Amazon FBA

* Online Arbitrage sourcing

* Keepa

* SellerAmp SAS

* Reading Keepa charts correctly

* Supplier lead times

* Gift cards and discount opportunities

* Coupon stacking

* Cashback websites

* Understanding Amazon fees

* ROI and profit calculations

* Product research and validation

* Consistent work is required

* Willing to learn and utilize courses & content opportunities I provide to you

* Must be willing to use Hubstaff for time logging



 What You'll Be Doing



* Finding profitable products for Amazon FBA

* Analyzing Keepa charts

* Checking SellerAmp SAS data

* Monitoring supplier websites

* Tracking coupon and gift card opportunities

* Identifying replenishable products

* Recording sourcing data accurately

* Communicating findings clearly



 IMPORTANT



To make sure applicants actually read this job posting, please answer ALL of the questions below at the VERY BEGINNING of your application before writing anything else.



Applications that do not answer these questions will be automatically rejected.



# Question 1



Provide:



1. An example of what you consider a GOOD Keepa chart and why.

2. When you would enter the market with said ASIN(season and dates). 

3. How you account for supplier lead time when analyzing a product.



# Question 2



Provide an example of a Keepa chart that was good but turned out to be a bad buy. Show when and where it went wrong using the data on the chart. 



Then explain at least THREE reasons why the product became a bad purchase.



Some examples can be provided upon request



# Question 3



What is your process for analyzing a product from start to finish?



Please include:



* Supplier website review

* Keepa analysis

* SellerAmp analysis

* Profit calculation

* Final decision process



# Question 4



What gift card, cashback, coupon stacking, or discount strategies have you personally used while sourcing products?



Please provide specific examples.



# Question 5



How many Amazon sellers are you currently sourcing for or have sourced for.



If more than one, please explain.





# Question 6 – Advanced Keepa Knowledge



Show me your knowledge of Keepa by completing both parts below.



## Part 1



Select an ASIN and explain how you would use Keepa to:



* Estimate how many units a specific seller has been selling.

* Monitor a seller's stock levels over time.

* Determine whether that seller is consistently replenishing inventory or running out of stock.

* Estimate that seller's monthly sales volume using Keepa data.



Please walk through your process step-by-step.



## Part 2



Using the same ASIN or a different ASIN, explain how you would:



* Determine which sellers have historically held the Buy Box.

* Identify whether the listing is Amazon-friendly, wholesale-friendly, private-label, or online-arbitrage friendly.

* Evaluate whether the Buy Box rotates fairly among sellers.

* Determine if a new seller would likely have a reasonable chance of winning the Buy Box.



Please include screenshots if possible and explain the specific Keepa data you are using to make your decisions.





# What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



* Pays attention to detail

* Communicates clearly

* Is honest and dependable

* Understands Amazon sourcing at an advanced level

* Can work independently

* Wants a long-term position

* Is willing to learn and grow with the business



Application Instructions

"I read the entire job posting and answered all questions."

title: Virtual Assistant for Real Estate Photography Company
description:
I run a real estate photography company serving the Chicago and Kansas City metro areas. We deliver listing photos, floor plans, drone media, 360 tours, videos, and other real estate marketing content.



I am looking for a reliable virtual assistant to help with daily media delivery, customer service, and client communication. The main focus of this role is making sure final media is delivered correctly and on time, especially in the mornings, while helping keep clients updated and organized.



What you will do

Media delivery and order management



• Monitor completed media and make sure deliverables are sent to clients

• Deliver final galleries, download links, floor plans, videos, 360 tours, and any other required files

• Make sure media is sent out by 9:00 AM CST whenever possible

• Confirm that each order has the correct files before delivery

• Follow up if something is missing or delayed

• Keep orders organized and update tracking sheets or internal notes

• Flag any issues clearly so they can be fixed quickly



Customer service and
 support



• Reply to client
s in a friendly, professional tone

• Answer common questions about delivery timing, download links, missing files, resends, edits, and order updates

• Help clients who are having trouble finding or downloading their media

• Keep client conversations organized so nothing gets missed

• Escalate anything urgent or unusual to me with a clear summary



Client updates and admin support



• Update clients when an order is delayed, completed, or needs more information

• Help with small tasks while I am out photographing, such as sending updates, checking order status, or following up with clients

• Complete tasks I assign throughout the day related to client communication, delivery, scheduling, or order management

• Help keep the business running smoothly when I am in the field



Real estate media quality awareness



• Understand what good real estate media should look like

• Be able to recognize obvious issues, such as missing rooms, incorrect files, blurry images, bad exports, wrong links, or incomplete deliverables

• Experience with real estate photography, listing media, property marketing, or real estate admin work is a strong plus



Tools we use



• Gmail

• Google Sheets

• Aryeo or similar real estate media delivery platforms

• Cloud storage and download links

• Real estate media platforms and client delivery systems



Plus if you know



• Aryeo

• Full Frame, HDPhotoHub, Rela, Tourbuzz, or similar real estate media platforms

• Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Photoshop or Lightroom

• Mailchimp

• Zapier or CRM tools

• Real estate listing workflows



Hours and schedule



This is a part-time role to start.



Most weeks, the schedule will be:



• Wednesday through Saturday

• Around 7:30 AM to 1:30 PM CST

• Approximately 20 to 25 hours per week



The most important coverage time is the morning because our goal is to have completed media delivered by 9:00 AM CST whenever possible. You must be reliable, responsive, and available during these hours.



There may be occasional extra tasks or schedule changes depending on workload.



Pay



Please include your hourly rate in your application.



I am happy to pay more for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, reliable, and able to take ownership of the delivery process.



What I am looking for



• Strong written English

• Excellent customer service instincts

• Very organized and detail-oriented

• Reliable morning availability, especially Wednesday through Saturday

• Comfortable learning systems quickly and following checklists

• Able to work independently and make smart judgment calls

• Calm under pressure with fast turnaround work

• Able to communicate clearly when something is missing, delayed, or needs my attention

• Experience supporting a service business is a plus

• Experience with real estate photography or real estate media workflows is a strong plus



How to apply



Please send:



A short intro and your relevant experience

Your hourly rate

Your timezone and typical working hours

Confirmation that you can usually work Wednesday through Saturday, around 7:30 AM to 1:30 PM CST

Which tools you have used, especially Gmail, Google Sheets, Aryeo, real estate media platforms, Adobe Creative Cloud, or Mailchimp

Any experience you have with real estate, photography, listing media, or customer service

Application questions

Tell me about a time you handled a frustrated customer over
. What did you say, and how did it end?

If a client says they cannot find their download link, what steps would you take?

If final photos are supposed to go out by 9:00 AM CST but one part of the order is missing, what would you do?

What real estate media platforms have you used, if any?

Have you worked with real estate photos, floor plans, drone media, 360 tours, or listing websites before? If yes, describe your experience.

How do you stay organized when you are managing multiple client requests at the same time?

What Adobe Creative Cloud tools have you used, if any, and what tasks did you do in them?

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Founding Technical Partner to Architect a Self-Healing, Al-Operated Company on AWS (Revenue Share + Exit Stake)
description:
This is not a task on a list. This is the engine.

I am building TalkTuit, an AI communications platform for the trades, plumbing and HVAC first. The product is the entry point. The real company is something rarer: a business that largely runs itself, where AI agents find leads, build and deliver each client's system, onboard them, watch the numbers, and repair their own failures before anyone notices.

I need one person, or one tight team, to architect and build that engine on AWS. Not a piece of it. The whole thing.

A bit about why this matters to me, because it tells you what kind of partner I am. I came up in the trades. About ten years ago a spinal cord injury left me quadriplegic, and I run this entire company by voice. I know exactly what it feels like to miss the phone while you are buried in a job, because I have lived both sides of it. I am not looking for hands to rent. I am looking for a great engineer who wants to keep doing what they are great at, on something that actually means something, and own a real piece of the outcome.

What you would build

The depth here is real, so I will be straight about it:

 The voice layer: production grade AI voice agents (Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs, Twilio) that answer, book, route, and summarize calls and sound genuinely human.

 The integration layer: connect those agents to ANY CRM a client already runs, through APIs and webhooks, never locked to one platform.

 The automation layer: end to end workflows (n8n and similar) that onboard clients, sync data, and run the business with as little human touch as possible.

 The growth engine: an automated demo system where a prospect replies to an
 and, within minutes, the system provisions a number, builds a personalized voice demo from their website, and sends it to them to try.

 The self-healing layer: monitoring and recovery so each client system and each internal system diagnoses and repairs itself, plus a recurring automated audit that catches problems before the client ever sees them.

 All of it on AWS, data rich, cost efficient at scale, documented, and clean enough to transfer at an exit.

Who you are

 You have built and shipped real production systems on AWS, not just demos.

 You live in AI agents and automation, and you can reason about architecture, not just wire up tools.

 Voice AI experience is a strong plus. CRM and API integration experience is a strong plus.

 You can work mostly independently and own outcomes, with some overlap with US Eastern time for working sessions.

 A person or a small team is both fine. If you bring a bench, even better.

This is a partnership, not a job

So we do not waste each other's time: this is structured as a partnership for the right fit. Revenue share that begins when revenue does, plus participation in the company's exit. Real upside, tied to what you help build, with the heavy lifting front loaded and the rewards compounding behind it. I keep majority ownership and control. You get a stake worth caring about. We talk specifics once we both know it is a fit.

If you want a steady hourly ticket with daily tasks handed to you, this honestly is not it, and that is okay.

The honest bar

I have interviewed a lot of people. This is one final round to find the rare fit I have not met yet. If the scope excited you instead of scaring you, I want to hear from you.

How to apply

Start your message with the word BUILT so I know you read this all the way through. Then tell me, in your own words:

 The most complex system you have built on AWS, and your specific role in it.

 Whether you work solo or bring a team, and who does what.

 One thing in the scope above you would architect differently, and why.

Show me something real you have built if you can. I read every serious message myself.

Let us build something that should not be possible.

title: Performance Video Editor – Direct Response Ads
description:
PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR – DIRECT RESPONSE ADS (Full-Time, Remote)



ABOUT US



We are LederKur — a fast-growing, six-figure German premium brand in the leather and wood care space. We sell direct-to-consumer through our own Shopify store and are scaling hard with Meta Ads as our main growth channel.



We are looking for a skilled and experienced Performance Video Editor who can take our scripts and turn them into scroll-stopping ad creatives that convert cold traffic into customers.



This is not a corporate video role. This is performance marketing. Every video you create has one job: make people stop scrolling, watch, and buy.





WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Receive ready-made ad scripts from the founder

- Source all clips yourself (stock footage, UGC-style footage, AI-generated clips)

- Edit and deliver 20 to 25 finished ad creatives per week (mix of full edits from scratch and variations such as hook swaps, new intros, format changes, and CTA tests)

- Create different ad formats: UGC-style ads, talking head ads, VSLs (Video Sales Letters), native-style video ads

- Add captions, text overlays, transitions, and sound design

- Follow direct response best practices: strong hook in the first 2 seconds, pattern interrupts, fast pacing, clear CTAs

- Deliver final files optimized for Meta Ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5)

- Iterate quickly when we give you feedback on what is working and what is not

- Build and maintain an organized clip library so you can move fast

- Test different hooks, openings, and visual styles based on performance data





WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Minimum 2 years of experience as a Performance Video Editor for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Expert-level video editing skills — use whatever software works best for you (CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or anything else). We do not care which tools you use. We care about the output.

- A strong portfolio that shows real direct response ad creatives (not brand films, not corporate videos, not wedding edits — we need ads that were built to sell)

- IMPORTANT: All videos are in German. All captions, text overlays, and on-screen copy must be in German. You will receive all scripts and text in German — your job is to place them correctly and make sure there are zero spelling or formatting errors.

- Deep understanding of what makes an ad convert: hooks, pacing, retention, visual storytelling

- Ability to source clips on your own without being told exactly where to find them

- Consistent speed: 20 to 25 creatives per week (full edits and variations combined) is the standard, not the exception

- Reliable high-speed internet and your own editing setup (computer, software, storage)

- Good written communication in English

- Ownership mentality: you take full responsibility for your output quality and deadlines





NICE TO HAVE (Not Required)



- Understanding or speaking German — this is a big plus since all content is in German, but not a requirement. You will receive all text ready to use.

- Experience with AI video tools (Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Motion graphics and animation skills

- Experience editing ads for the German or European market

- Thumbnail and static image creation skills

- Basic understanding of Meta Ads performance metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate)





COMPENSATION



- $5 per hour USD (full-time, 40 hours per week)

- Full-time remote position

- Performance bonuses for creatives that hit strong results

- Long-term role with room to grow as the brand scales

- Salary increases based on performance reviews





WORK SETUP



- Fully remote — work from anywhere

- Full-time (40 hours per week)

- You must have overlap with European business hours (CET) for daily communication and feedback

- This is a fast-paced, high-output environment. We test constantly, iterate quickly, and move with urgency.

- You will communicate directly with the founder. No layers. No politics. Just clear direction and fast execution.





TOOLS WE USE



- Your editing software of choice — whatever makes you fastest and delivers the best output

- Google Drive (file sharing and delivery)

- Meta Ads Manager (for performance feedback and context)

- Shopify (our store — for product and brand context)





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please send the following:



1. Your portfolio or showreel — must include direct response / performance ad creatives you have personally edited (not team projects, not brand films)

2. A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes maximum) where you explain:

   - How long you have been editing performance ads

   - Your process when you receive a script: how do you go from script to finished creative?

   - One example from your portfolio: what was the goal, what did you do, what was the result?

3. Your expected hourly rate in USD

4. Your earliest available start date

5. Your current editing setup (computer specs, internet speed, software you own)





READ THIS CAREFULLY:



To confirm that you have read this entire job post from top to bottom, you MUST write our brand name in the FIRST LINE of your application message. If you do not know our brand name, you did not read the post. Applications without this will be ignored — no exceptions.





We are looking for one person. The right person. If that is you, we want to hear from you today.

title: SENIOR IT ENGINEER (MSP) - Projects, Networking, and Escalations - True North IT (Remote - Philippines)
description:
SENIOR IT ENGINEER (MSP)

Projects, Networking, and Escalations



We are a small MSP. Our clients are mostly in healthcare, manufacturing, and compliance focused industries, and they rely on us as their full IT department. Five people on the team. We are growing, and we are looking for a senior engineer who can own high level project work end to end and be the experienced hand the team brings the tougher problems to.



This is a senior role. Most of your week is project work, and a real part of it is being the person the team escalates to when something tricky comes in. We are looking for someone who can take a scope of work, think through the best approach, propose a solution, and run with it. Onboard a new client into our full service stack. Configure a Fortinet firewall remotely while a local tech racks the hardware. Harden a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Document everything thoroughly so the next person does not have to start from scratch.



We value first principles thinking and expert troubleshooting. When you encounter a situation you have not seen before, we expect you to research it, reason through it, suggest your approach, and execute once we align. You will be solving real problems across a diverse client base, and no two weeks look the same.



You will work primarily on project deliverables, onboarding execution, and the escalations that need a senior set of hands. You like the ownership of running a project from scope to delivery, and you are also the person others can lean on when something hard comes in. As we get to know your work and your communication, there will be room to take on more responsibility over time.



What you will be doing



Full client onboardings: RMM deployment, M365 tenant baselining, security hardening, service stack tooling, documentation buildout.



Microsoft 365 security and identity work: conditional access policies, Entra ID configuration, compliance policies, DLP, MFA.



Remote network and firewall configuration: IP schema design, VLANs, security policies, VPN setup. Fortinet experience is ideal. UniFi familiarity is a plus.



Migration projects: tenant to tenant, Google to M365, IMAP, SharePoint, and on premises Active Directory to Entra ID.



Intune and endpoint management: enrollment, compliance policies, app deployment, Autopilot. Migrating endpoints from RMM only management to Intune managed. Apple Business Manager and MDM for macOS environments.



Automation and scripting. Building and maintaining scripts to streamline internal processes and client environments. You will also work with AI development tools on internal systems projects.



Escalations. Picking up the harder service board issues that need an experienced hand, during your overlap hours.



Documentation of everything you touch in our internal knowledge base.



What we are looking for



3 to 5 years or more in an MSP environment. You have managed multiple client tenants at once, worked within a PSA and ticketing system, and you understand the pace and context switching that comes with supporting a diverse client base.



Deep Microsoft 365 administration and security experience. Not just mailbox management. We mean conditional access, Entra ID, identity governance, compliance policies.



Real Intune proficiency: enrollment, compliance baselines, app deployment, Autopilot. Comfortable migrating endpoints from RMM only management into Intune managed environments.



Cybersecurity proficiency. You understand conditional access policy design, security baselines, MFA enforcement, and identity protection. Experience with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other compliance frameworks is important. We serve regulated industries and our clients depend on us to get this right.



Solid networking fundamentals with hands on firewall configuration experience. Fortinet preferred, others considered.



Migration experience across different scenarios: tenant to tenant, Google Workspace, IMAP, on premises Active Directory to Entra ID.



Automation and scripting experience. PowerShell, bash, or similar. You look for ways to automate repetitive work in tools like your RMM, PSA, or other platform APIs. Experience with AI coding tools or workflow automation platforms is a strong plus.



Excellent written and spoken English. You will be communicating with tea
mbers in the US in Teams throughout the day and occasionally joining client calls.



Strong documentation habits. If you did not document it, it did not happen.



First principles thinker. When something breaks or a project takes an unexpected turn, you research, reason through it, and come back with a recommended path forward.



Self directed. You receive a scope of work and we trust you to execute it, flag blockers, and submit milestones for review without being managed step by step.



Certifications



Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) and MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator) within ninety days of hire, or a genuine willingness to earn them. We cover the exam fees and study materials. Holding either already puts you ahead.



Nice to have



Experience with any of our toolstack: NinjaRMM, HaloPSA, Huntress, ImmyBot, CIPP, Hudu.



Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS endpoint management.



Fortinet NSE certification or equivalent.



Experience with AI coding tools, workflow automation, or building internal tooling. We are an AI forward team and actively building in this space.



What we offer



Full time remote work. $2,320 per month, with permanent pay increases tied to certifications earned. Exam fees and study materials covered. Interesting project work across a diverse client base. A team that communicates well and trusts you to own your work.



At least four hours of daily overlap with US Mountain Time, with flexibility for more during the onboarding period.



This role starts with a sixty day trial period so we can both make sure it is a good fit.



How to apply



To be considered, your application must include BOTH of these:



1. YOUR RESUME

2. A VIDEO, FIVE TO EIGHT MINUTES, ANSWERING ONE OF THE QUESTIONS BELOW



Both parts are required. The applications we move forward are the ones that include both your resume and your video, so please send them together in the same application. The video is the first thing we watch, so make sure it is there.



For the video, pick the ONE question below that fits you best and walk us through your approach. Use real examples from your own experience wherever you can. We care most about HOW you think, so talk us through it the way you would in a tea
eting with your peers. We are looking for candidates that can speak naturally about their experience, rather than just reading an AI script.



Answer ONE of these:



1. You are onboarding a 50 person company onto Microsoft 365. They are currently on Google Workspace. Walk us through your first two weeks: what you do, in what order, and the gotchas you would watch for.



2. A client needs a Fortinet firewall configured remotely. A local tech will rack it and give you console access. Walk us through how you would plan the deployment: IP schema, VLANs, security policies, and what you would document when you are done.



3. You are hardening a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Which conditional access policies do you implement first, and why in that order?

title: Long-Form Video Editor — YouTube Content (Business / Agency Niche)
description:
The role



I run a UK-based marketing consultancy that publishes long-form business content on YouTube. I'm building out a proper content engine and need a reliable long-form editor to take over the editing side so I can focus on filming, strategy, and running the business.



Pay: $560/month

Schedule: 3–4 edited videos per week (roughly one every two days)

Video length: 10–30 minutes per edit

Start: ASAP



This is a recurring monthly role, not a one-off project. If you do good work and hit deadlines, this is stable, predictable work for the long term.



What you'll be editing



Long-form YouTube videos in the business / marketing / agency niche. Talking head + b-roll + screen recordings + occasional chart overlays.



The style is conversational, educational, direct — NOT high-energy MrBeast or hype-bro YouTube. The tone is British, calm, math-transparent, and anti-hype. Think Alex Hormozi's earlier long-form content or Sam Ovens — clean, professional, slightly opinionated, no flashy zoom-in-zoom-out every 3 seconds.



If you've ever edited "$10,000 in 30 days" type content, this is the opposite of that.



Your daily / weekly responsibilities





Receive raw footage in Google Drive (usually 30–60 min of raw ? 10–30 min edited)

Cut filler, dead air, ums/ahs, and mistakes

Build a tight, retention-focused first 30 seconds (this is the most important part of every edit — YouTube's primary distribution signal lives here)

Add b-roll from royalty-free sources (Pexels, Storyblocks) where it improves pacing

Add on-screen text overlays for key points, statistics, and frameworks

Colour correct talking head footage

Clean up audio (noise reduction, level balancing)

Add captions / subtitles (auto-generated, then manually corrected)

Export final and upload to a Google Drive output folder

Turnaround: deliver each finished edit within 48 hours of receiving raw footage





What you need to have



Required:





Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve — fully proficient, not just basics

2+ years editing long-form YouTube content (not just shorts/reels)

Strong English comprehension — you'll be transcribing and editing British-accented audio

Reliable internet (you'll be downloading and uploading large files daily)

A track record of hitting deadlines without me having to chase you





Bonus (will move your application to the top of the pile):





Thumbnail design experience (Photoshop or Figma)

Experience cutting reels / shorts from long-form source files

Past work editing business, marketing, or agency content

Understanding of YouTube algorithm basics — retention curves, hook structure, CTR signals





What I'm NOT looking for





Editors who add flashy zoom-bounces, 
 sound effects, or constant motion graphics. Restraint is more valuable than flair on this channel.

Generic application messages with no portfolio links.

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates or misses deadlines.

Editors who only have experience with short-form / reels — I need someone who understands long-form pacing.

Pay: $560/month

Start: ASAP



This is a long-term, recurring role. If you do good work, this is stable monthly income for as long as you want it.



What you'll actually be doing



A mix of operational and lifestyle tasks. Some examples of typical requests:





Travel: "Book me a flight London Gatwick to Larnaca next Friday returning Tuesday, prefer morning departures, business class." You handle the research, options, booking, calendar entry, confirmation tracking.

Property: "Find me 5 three-bed houses in Limassol with a pool, under €1.2m. Send a shortlist with photos, prices, and key details." You compile the shortlist.

Weekend trips: "Plan a long weekend in Athens. Hotel, 3 dinners, 2 day activities, total budget €3k." You design the itinerary.

Restaurants: "Find me the best Mediterranean restaurants in Nicosia under €100/head with outdoor seating." You research and send a shortlist with reservations links.

Schedule management: Keep my calendar organized, block out focus time, reschedule conflicts proactively, remind me of upcoming commitments before I forget them.

Operational support: Track recurring deadlines (passport renewals, business filings, subscription reviews), maintain my contact lists, manage personal admin.





The role evolves — what's repetitive becomes automated, new things get added. You need to be the kind of person who builds the system, not the kind who waits to be told.



What separates a great applicant from a mediocre one



The best PA I've worked with thinks two steps ahead. If I ask for a flight, they include a hotel option too. If I'
eting someone in a new city, they pre-emptively send the address, parking info, and a backup café in case the first venue is closed. Reactive PAs send what I asked for; great PAs anticipate what I'll need next.



If that sounds like how you naturally operate, this role will work for you. If you need a detailed brief for every single task, it won't.



What you need to have



Required:

title: Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online (Australian Tax & GST)
description:
Cleanup, Restructure & Ongoing Bookkeeping  ·  Remote (Philippines)

Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness



Engagement Part-time, long-term — around 15-20 hours/week once established (more during the initial cleanup)

Hours Flexible and deadline-based — we care that the work is done well and on time, not that you sit set hours each day

Software QuickBooks Online (we are staying on QuickBooks — this is a QBO role)

Reports to Business owner

Start As soon as we find the right person



About us

We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling premium Wagyu and grass-fed beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range. We need one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping so we can focus on running the business.

The role

We have used QuickBooks for many years and have a lot of history in the file. We are staying on QuickBooks — we are NOT migrating to Xero. The first big job is a thorough cleanup and restructure of our existing QuickBooks Online file so that each of our enterprises reports clearly and our GST is correct. After that, you keep everything reconciled, accurately coded, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax.

Important: BAS and tax documents are prepared by you and reviewed/lodged by the owner. You prepare; we review and lodge.

What you will do

• Clean up and restructure our existing QuickBooks Online file — review the chart of accounts, remove duplicates, fix inconsistent coding, and set up a clean, consistent structure (you would confirm the proposed structure with us before making major changes).

• Set up each enterprise to report separately (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations where helpful), so we can see income and expenses for each part of the business.

• Process and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions across multiple accounts.

• Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim. You apply the right GST code to every transaction, and review and correct existing coding during the cleanup.

• Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting documents for the owner to review and lodge.

• Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position, and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking.

• Flag any errors, unusual transactions, or anything without supporting documentation, rather than guessing. We value someone who asks and flags rather than assumes.

Must have

• Solid hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online — including cleaning up and restructuring an established file, not just data entry. (This is essential. Please only apply if you are genuinely experienced in QuickBooks Online.)

• Good understanding of Australian GST, including the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases, and BAS preparation.

• Experience using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations) for separating and reporting on different parts of a business.

• A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed.

• Reliable, responsive, and able to work independently to deadlines. Good written English, reliable internet, and your own computer.

• Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information.

Nice to have

• Experience with Australian clients and Australian BAS/tax.

• Experience with multi-enterprise, farming, or primary-production accounts.

• Payroll / STP experience.

Why work with us

• Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility.

• Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry.

• Flexible, deadline-based hours — we trust you to manage your own time and deliver.

How to apply

Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it shows us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. Please send:

1. Your CV / resume (pasted into your reply or attached through OnlineJobs.ph please — not a Google Drive link).

2. A short note on your QuickBooks Online experience — in particular, any file cleanups or restructures you’ve done.

3. Your experience with Australian GST and BAS.

4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available.

And please answer these three quick questions in your application:

• In QuickBooks Online, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business?

• If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books?

• If you took over a messy QuickBooks file with duplicate accounts and inconsistent coding, how would you approach cleaning it up?

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

We are a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer health brand looking for an elite, data-backed Direct-Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist. We are looking for an angle-hunter, a script-master, and a conversion-mechanic rolled into one.



We do not write generic, corporate marketing copy, nor do we build standard e-commerce funnels. We create high-stakes, logically airtight, direct-to-consumer health campaigns.



If you are the type of writer who relies on basic adjectives, template formats, and surface-level benefits, please do not apply. But if you actively breathe Eugene Schwartz’s Breakthrough Advertising principles, know exactly how to manipulate Market Sophistication and Awareness levels, and execute the RMBC Method flawlessly under tight deadlines, this role is engineered for you.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

End-to-End Creative Strategy & Ideation: You won’t just take orders; you will lead the creative direction. You will deep-dive into market research, analyze ad comments and forums, review customer data, and dream up completely fresh visual hooks and positioning angles to scale our media buying spend.



Write Category-Defining VSLs (~3-5 Minutes): You will craft high-retention, problem-aware video scripts utilizing psychological pattern-interrupts and visceral, real-world analogies. You must be able to pitch a severe physical crisis and bridge it seamlessly to a proprietary solution without losing the user's logic or trust.



Draft Long-Form Hybrid PDPs: You will reverse-engineer standard, boring e-commerce checkout pages and convert them into long-form editorial landing pages that seamlessly function as high-converting checkout carts.



Write Native Advertorials: You will script top-of-funnel presell articles that systematically dismantle mainstream band-aids and open a massive curiosity loop that drives massive clicks to our main offers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE

Mastery of Market Awareness & Sophistication: You understand how to market to a highly saturated, highly skeptical consumer base. You know how to take a Problem-Aware prospect (someone experiencing real physical symptoms but clueless about the underlying biological cause) and bypass their defensive walls by targeting a hidden, external enemy.



The RMBC Method (Research, Mechanism, Brief, Copy): This is non-negotiable. You must deeply understand how to isolate a Unique Mechanism of the Problem (UMP) and a Unique Mechanism of the Solution (UMS) to form a bulletproof, logical chain.



Simplification of Complex Science: You know how to take advanced biological concepts and translate them into clear, simple, punchy, real-world analogies (e.g., explaining bodily pipelines using concepts like plumbing, traffic jams, collapsed highways, or rusted pipes).



Visual Storyboarding: You write copy with the video editor in mind. Every line of your script must explicitly dictate a clear, second-by-second visual action, b-roll directive, or high-contrast text overlay to maximize video hold-rates.



QUALIFICATIONS

3+ years of verifiable direct-response copywriting and creative strategy experience in the supplement, health, longevity, or financial publishing verticals.



A portfolio showcasing winning VSLs, long-form landing pages, or advertorials that have generated consistent, profitable ROAS on cold traffic platforms (Meta, Google, YouTube).



Direct study or formal training in ancestral direct-response frameworks (Breakthrough Advertising, Stefan Georgi’s RMBC framework, or classic Agora-style copywriting models).



High speed of execution. You can research a bodily mechanism deeply, map out a full creative strategy brief, and execute a clean first draft efficiently without endless corporate hand-holding.



WHAT WE OFFER

Profitable Scaling Environment: Our media buying team is world-class. Your winning hooks, scripts, angles, and landing pages will immediately be backed by substantial daily ad spend.



ROAS Bonuses: When your copy and creative strategy wins, you win. We offer direct performance bonuses tied to scaling the conversion rates and average order values (AOV) of your campaigns.



Complete Creative Autonomy: No slow, painful corporate committees. We move fast, split-test aggressively, and rely entirely on what the data dictates.



TO APPLY:

Please send over a brief introduction outlining your experience with the RMBC method, your background in managing Creative Strategy, and 2-3 links to live or past direct-response assets (VSLs, PDPs, Advertorials, or ad briefs) that showcase your ability to convert cold traffic.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA VA) Product Researcher
description:
Company: We are TheVault, a seven-figure e-commerce group operating multiple Amazon storefronts that source in coordination, plus active Walmart Marketplace storefronts that accumulate to six-figure in revenue.



Type: Remote (work from home).

Compensation: Competitive base and quarterly performance bonuses.

Schedule: Flexible and Philippine hours welcome. Five days a week, must work weekends.

Preferred overlap: 6AM to 2PM (your local PH time) so your leads are ready for our EST morning review.



About the Role

We are hiring one sharp, profitable Online Arbitrage (OA) product researcher to join a process-driven team of serious sellers. You will source profitable leads daily across Amazon (and occasionally Walmart), vet them against our buying criteria, and deliver clean, decision-ready data to the team. This is not a "spray and pray" lead farm. We value accuracy, margin discipline, and judgment over raw volume. You will be among other Virtual Assistants working within a professional workspace, with real SOPs, real tools, real coaching, and a real growth path.



Detail check (most applicants miss this): when you
 us, make the very first line of your message the single word VELOCITY — on its own line.



What You'll Do

— Source profitable OA/RA leads daily using SAS and Keepa.

— Vet every lead for ROI, sell-through velocity, Buy Box behavior, IP/gating risk, and competition.

— Deliver all found, organized leads in our 
/ Database Website with sourcing links and your analysis on each profitable lead found.

— Flag potential risks (price-tanking, Amazon on listing, OOS patterns, hazmat, gating) before we buy.

— Maintain a profitable, accountable track record (we measure outcomes).



Required Qualifications

— 3+ years proven OA/RA product research experience with a profitable track record (work experience mandatory).

— Reliable internet; able to do video and voice calls.

— Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

— Fluent English with great written communication.



Required tools:

— SAS (Seller Amp), Keepa

Familiarity with:

— SmartScout, Tactical Arbitrage, RevSeller, Helium 10



Preferred / Bonus Qualifications:

— Amazon VA training certification(s)

— Experience with InventoryLab and Sellerboard (or comparable P&L tools)

— Exposure to Walmart Marketplace policies and the ability to transfer Amazon best practices to Walmart (we welcome Walmart leads as we sell there too)



Employee Benefits:

— Quarterly performance bonuses for meeting team goals

— Competitive pay compared to other employers

— Philippine national holidays honored

— Supportive, process-driven team with tools, SOPs, and coaching to help you win

— Growth path inside a fast-moving, seven-figure operation



ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW



HOW TO APPLY, READ EVERY WORD:

The single most important trait of a great researcher is attention to detail. So our application is the first test. Applications that skip or miss any instruction below will not be reviewed— no exceptions. This is deliberate. If you can't follow our application instructions, you can't follow our sourcing SOPs.



There are three stages:



STAGE 1 is Application
 (Screening)

Send an
 with your resume attached and complete all of the following exactly:

1. Subject line, use this exact format: OA RESEARCHER – [YOUR FULL NAME] – [YOUR FAVORITE FOOD]

2. First line of your
 body must be the code word we hid earlier in this listing, on its own line at the very top. We won't tell you where it is— careful readers will have already found it.

3. A brief introduction. Sell yourself. Tell us about your real, profitable OA/RA experience and what you've personally sourced.

4. Reference one specific line from this listing that resonated with you, and explain why in one or two sentences.



5. Answer the sourcing math problem below. Show your work on a piece of paper and attach it to your application. Do not just give the final number:

A product sells for $29.99 on Amazon. Your unit cost is $14.50. Amazon's referral fee is 15% of the sale price, and the FBA fulfillment fee is $5.45 per unit.

(a) What is your net profit per unit?

(b) What is your ROI %?

(c) Would you source this product? At what minimum ROI and/or minimum profit do you personally pull the trigger, and why?



6. Confirm your availability for the preferred 6AM to 2PM PH overlap, or propose your hours.

— To prove you read this far: end your
 with the exact phrase "Leads ready by morning." Applications missing this phrase are auto-declined.



STAGE 2 is Keepa & OA Knowledge Test (No Interview Yet)

If your application is clean, we'll send you a short written test (answered in your own words, no copy-paste from Google or AI). that looks like this:

— On a Keepa chart, what does a drop (downward spike) in the Sales Rank line indicate? How would you use the "Sales Rank Drops – Last 30 / 90 days" figures to estimate monthly sales velocity?

— How do you use Keepa to determine how often Amazon itself is on a listing, and why does that change your buying decision?

— A listing shows a current Buy Box of $24.99, but Keepa shows the Buy Box bouncing between $18–$25 over 90 days. What does that pattern tell you, and would you still buy? Defend your answer.

— Walk us through every check you run on a lead before you submit it to us (in order).



We grade on accuracy and reasoning, not length. Fakers get filtered here.



STAGE 3 is the Zoom Interview

Only candidates who pass Stages 1 and 2 are invited to a Zoom interview with the team. Reliable video/voice required.



Timeline: We review applications within 1–3 business days. We move fast on strong candidates and we don't waste good people's time. If you've read this whole listing, followed every instruction, and you genuinely know your numbers: we want to hear from you.
